tests.case: leaving the page cancels its named request and a late success cannot reload or move focus
registers before dispatch and only the requesting renderer can cancel

MergeSuggestionRefreshTests.Leaving_full.reason: Unmount aborts the exact page-owned request, forwards its cancellation through the bridge, and prevents a late response from reloading identity data or changing the next page's focus. Main-process ownership isolates cancellation from other renderers.

tests.case: merges all selected groups under their chosen parents with sequential revisions and one bulk Undo
retains only completed bulk acts for Undo when a later group conflicts
answers twenty of sixty cards with one authoritative read per answer and preserves all sixty DOM slots

MergeQueueViewModelTests.Answering_reads.reason: The literal zero-repository-read counter is specific to retired in-process answering. The mandatory HTTP architecture preserves CAS and uses exactly one authoritative GET after each answer. Both surfaces retain all 60 DOM card instances/positions after 20 answers, leave 40 pending, write 20 acts and no candidate dismissals. The real 60/20 HTTP test preserves all entities/statuses. Dated local Debug measurement: POST mean10.60/max14.81ms, GET mean58.09/max69.67ms, combined max80.54ms; .tmp/merge-decision-results/merge-decision-parity.trx. These are observations, not a CI latency guarantee or a claim of zero-read parity.
